description: Get one post by id: status (a scheduled post that was paused with pause_post reads paused; scheduledAt is kept), needsReschedule (true when the post was approved after its scheduled time, or is still unapproved past it: it will not auto-publish until the user picks a new time in the app; also per target), scheduledAt, publishedAt, permalink, platformPostId (null until published), approvalRequired and approval {required, approvedAt, approverName, changeRequestNote} (same shape as get_approval_status), Evergreen recycling settings (recyclingEnabled, recyclingIntervalDays, recyclingMaxRepeats, recyclingExpiresAt) and, per target (network), its channel, accountId, status, needsReschedule, platformPostId, permalink (link to the post on that network, null until published) publishedAt and deletedOnNetworkAt (ISO time the post was found deleted directly on that network, null otherwise; when set the permalink no longer works), plus its first comment (text, delayMinutes, status, permalink). A WORDPRESS target also carries a `wordpress` block: title, slug, excerpt, wpStatus, categoryIds, tagIds, featuredImage {url, alt} and the article body contentHtml, so an article can be read back before update_post. The post-level permalink is the Instagram one; use targets[].permalink for Threads and other networks.
name: get_post
title: Get post
